packs.title: Patient appointment journey
packs.scope: Patient-facing appointment services; excludes emergency triage, diagnosis, and treatment instructions.

concepts.name: Find a clinician
concepts.meaning: Compare suitable care providers.

concepts.name: Book an appointment
concepts.meaning: Request a visit using a booking interface.

concepts.name: Choose a time
concepts.meaning: Select an available appointment slot.

concepts.name: Appointment confirmed
concepts.meaning: A requested visit is now scheduled.

concepts.name: Visit reminder
concepts.meaning: An upcoming visit needs attention.

concepts.name: Pre-visit questionnaire
concepts.meaning: Complete questions before the visit.

concepts.name: Bring records
concepts.meaning: Prepare existing medical documents.

concepts.name: Access accommodation
concepts.meaning: Arrange step-free access or mobility support.

concepts.name: Arrival and check-in
concepts.meaning: Register arrival at the reception desk.

concepts.name: Waiting room
concepts.meaning: Wait until the care team is ready.

concepts.name: Vitals check
concepts.meaning: Measure basic observations before consultation.

concepts.name: Clinical consultation
concepts.meaning: Discuss concerns with a care professional.

concepts.name: Diagnostic referral
concepts.meaning: Move from a visit to an ordered diagnostic service.

concepts.name: Prescription
concepts.meaning: Receive a medication plan from the clinician.

concepts.name: Follow-up plan
concepts.meaning: Schedule a next visit after the current one.

concepts.name: Reschedule a visit
concepts.meaning: Move an existing booking to a different slot.

concepts.name: Cancel a visit
concepts.meaning: Remove a scheduled visit without replacing it.

concepts.name: Telehealth visit
concepts.meaning: Consult remotely through a video connection.

packs.title: Human approval in AI workflows
packs.scope: Approval and oversight of AI-proposed actions; excludes vendor logos and claims that approval alone guarantees safety.

concepts.name: AI-proposed action
concepts.meaning: A model produces a proposed action, not an executed one.

concepts.name: Pending review queue
concepts.meaning: Proposals wait in an ordered review backlog.

concepts.name: Assigned reviewer
concepts.meaning: A specific human owns the review decision.

concepts.name: Review supporting evidence
concepts.meaning: Inspect sources before deciding.

concepts.name: Request human approval
concepts.meaning: Route a proposed action to a person.

concepts.name: Approve execution
concepts.meaning: A deliberate human decision opens the execution path.

concepts.name: Reject proposal
concepts.meaning: A review decision stops the proposed action.

concepts.name: Request changes
concepts.meaning: Return a proposal for revision and another review.

concepts.name: Delegate review
concepts.meaning: Transfer review ownership to another human.

concepts.name: Multiple approvals
concepts.meaning: A proposal requires agreement from more than one reviewer.

concepts.name: Permission boundary
concepts.meaning: An action must remain inside an explicitly permitted scope.

concepts.name: Sensitive action
concepts.meaning: High-impact operations need heightened authorization.

concepts.name: Review timeout
concepts.meaning: An unanswered approval expires rather than silently succeeding.

concepts.name: Escalate review
concepts.meaning: Route a blocked decision to a higher-authority reviewer.

concepts.name: Gated execution
concepts.meaning: Only an approved action crosses the execution boundary.

concepts.name: Decision audit receipt
concepts.meaning: Record the actor, decision, and action in a durable trace.

concepts.name: Revoke approval
concepts.meaning: Withdraw permission before a pending action executes.

concepts.name: Human override
concepts.meaning: A person interrupts automated execution through an explicit control.

packs.title: Disagreement and debate
packs.scope: Constructive interpersonal disagreement; no conflict diagnosis, stereotypes, or claims of universally correct emotional responses.

concepts.name: Different viewpoints
concepts.meaning: Two people see the same situation differently.

concepts.name: State a position
concepts.meaning: One speaker presents a clear point of view.

concepts.name: Listen before responding
concepts.meaning: Attend to another person without preparing a rebuttal.

concepts.name: Interrupting
concepts.meaning: Overlapping speech blocks an unfinished contribution.

concepts.name: Ask for clarification
concepts.meaning: A question opens space for understanding.

concepts.name: Bring evidence
concepts.meaning: Offer information that can be examined together.

concepts.name: Challenge an assumption
concepts.meaning: Inspect the premise beneath a confident claim.

concepts.name: Respectful disagreement
concepts.meaning: Express a different view without attacking the person.

concepts.name: Conversation heats up
concepts.meaning: Rising intensity makes the exchange harder to navigate.

concepts.name: Pause the discussion
concepts.meaning: Take a deliberate break instead of escalating.

concepts.name: Set a boundary
concepts.meaning: State a limit while remaining engaged.

concepts.name: Reframe the question
concepts.meaning: Change the frame to reveal another useful interpretation.

concepts.name: Find common ground
concepts.meaning: Identify a meaningful area of agreement.

concepts.name: Explore trade-offs
concepts.meaning: Recognize that each option has benefits and costs.

concepts.name: Negotiate a compromise
concepts.meaning: Both sides adjust to reach a workable middle.

concepts.name: Invite a mediator
concepts.meaning: A third person helps structure a difficult exchange.

concepts.name: Agree to disagree
concepts.meaning: Respectfully retain different conclusions.

concepts.name: Commit to a next step
concepts.meaning: End with a concrete action rather than an unresolved loop.
